title: Team tools and self-scheduled work sessions

approved.quote: lets get them all the tools they need and yes give them what they need

grants: Kin on the roster (config/agents.json), as members of teams (teams/teams.json), may run scheduled work sessions (scripts/team-agent.mjs) on their teams' own schedule (teams/schedule.json).

In a session: web search and page fetching; reading the repository; writing anything inside their own team folders, committed directly (default yes, reversible through git); running Python in a sandbox; filing and updating board tasks; appending their standup and their own memory entry.
limits: Writes only inside teams/<own team>/. STANDUP.md is append-only, through finish().
The Python sandbox runs as an unprivileged user on a copy of teams/ and context/, with no API keys, no repository credentials, and a 120-second limit.
The four lines in context/00-mission.md apply: no spending outside the agreed process, no pretending to be human, no passwords, keys, or private data, follow the law.
At most 4 sessions per team per day, and 14 tool steps per session (TEAM_MAX_STEPS).
revocation: Set status to "revoked"; sessions stop at the next wake. Everything written stays in git.
